conversion_factor: AGB Mg/ha = Mg C/ha * 2.0 (assuming 0.50 C fraction)

feature_importance.description: ETH Global Canopy Height (10m) calibrated with GEDI LiDAR (meters)
SWIR-2 (2190 nm) - Lignin, cellulose, and moisture sensitivity
Normalized Difference Veg Index (B8-B4)/(B8+B4) - Green canopy density
NIR (842 nm) - Leaf cellular structure and high canopy scattering
S1 C-band VV backscatter in dB - Ground-trunk double bounce interaction
S1 C-band VH backscatter in dB - Volume scattering from branches, leaves, and canopy
Blue (490 nm) - Atmospheric baseline and shadow differentiation
SWIR-1 (1610 nm) - Canopy water absorption and dry biomass proxy
Soil-Adjusted Veg Index - Minimizes soil background brightness effects
Normalized Difference Water Index (B8-B11)/(B8+B11) - Canopy moisture content
Enhanced Veg Index - Sensitive in high-biomass dense canopy without saturating
Radar Vegetation Index: volume scattering fraction indicator

quality_summary: Multi-biome model v2 trained across tropical, savanna, and arid biomes using unified NASA/ORNL AGB reference. Overall Validation R² = 0.862, RMSE = 10.80 Mg/ha, MAE = 5.62 Mg/ha. Thar Desert held-out validation evaluated relative to arid range [0.0 - 2.1 Mg/ha].
